ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (20) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Братство» (bratstvo) is 'brotherhood' throughout, and «сознание» (soznanie) 'consciousness'; «начало» (nachalo) is 'source', as elsewhere in the book. The Gospel words in Lamennais and Tolstoy's closing «едино стадо и един пастырь» (edino stado i edin pastyr', 'one flock and one shepherd') are translated from the Russian, and «отец» (otets, 'father') keeps the source's lowercase.
